test_title: Arithmetical and Numerical Ability Mock Test 33

questions.question: A customer purchases a product for ₹550 after a 12% discount. What was the marked price?
If the mean proportion of 24 and A is 72, then what is the value of A?
While going shopping to a mall, Priya travels at a speed of 28 km/hr and on her way back, she travels at a speed of 84 km/hr. What is her average speed for the whole journey (in km/hr)?
While going to a shopping mall, Anjali travels at a speed of 42 km/hr and on her way back, she travels at a speed of 56 km/hr. What is her average speed (in km/hr) for the whole journey?
How much will a sum of ₹53,000 become after one year if the interest is compounded half-yearly at 20% per annum compound interest?
A pipe can fill a tank in 18 hours. Another pipe can empty the filled tank in 24 hours. If both the pipes are opened simultaneously, then the time (in hours) in which the tank will be filled is:
Find the value of 53 −2  ÷ 53 12  × 53 −5.
The average of 7 numbers is 49. If each number is decreased by 4, what will the new average be?
If the ratio of two numbers is 2 : 9 and their HCF is 22, then their LCM is:
A spherical tank has a diameter of 18 m. Calculate its volume. (Use π = 3.14)
On a certain sum, simple interest for 2 years at 20% per annum is ₹1,142. Find the sum (in ₹).
Amit purchased 10 kg of rice at the rate of ₹38 per kg and 31 kg of rice at ₹44 per kg. He sold the whole mixture at the rate of ₹42 per kg. Find his loss (in ₹).
2 men or 8 women can do a job in 3 days. 2 men work for 1 days and leave. The number of women required to complete the remaining work in 8 days is:
A batsman in his 14th inning makes a score of 91 runs, thereby increasing his average by 1 run. Find his average runs after the 14th inning.
The average weight of Vipul, Mohan and Mohammad is 45 kg. If the average weight of Vipul and Mohan is 37 kg and that of Mohan and Mohammad is 44 kg, then the weight of Mohan (in kg) is:
A vendor sold 28 chocolates for ₹1, thereby gaining 25%. How many chocolates did he buy for ₹1?
A train goes from A to B at a speed of 9 km/hr and returns from B to A by the same route at 18 km/hr. The average speed (in km/hr) of the train during the two-way journey is:

The list price of an article is ₹5,700, and a discount of 6% is offered on the list price. What additional discount percentage on the already discounted price must be offered to a customer to bring the net selling price to ₹1,875.30?
The total surface area (in m2) of a cube, each of whose edges measures 119 m, is:

A man spends 76% of his monthly salary (in ₹) on the rent of his house. If every month he also spends ₹976 on his conveyance and ₹5,629 on his grocery and saves the remaining ₹349, his monthly salary (in ₹) is:
